verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is a card-issuing API, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence only shows Stripe publishing its own MCP server for other agents to use. That is the server role and belongs to a different story, so it cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
